narrative.overview: The public WorkPulse landing page is a warm editorial identity for a serious workforce product. Warm ivory and muted sand make the page considered and human; deep maroon and black provide authority, while white, soft white, gray, and paper dividers keep information legible. The distinctive hero remains the anchor, followed by editorial rows that explain real product value without turning every capability into a card. This palette is scoped to the public landing; authenticated app and business surfaces may retain existing semantic/application tokens.

rules.name: The Warm Ledger Rule
rules.body: Keep the public landing palette to the named warm neutrals, maroon, black, white, and semantic green.

rules.name: The Semantic Green Rule
rules.body: Green appears only when it communicates a real status.

rules.name: The Editorial Rhythm Rule
rules.body: Use a 1200-1280px container, 100-130px section spacing, thin dividers, and varied below-hero rows.

rules.name: The Earned Depth Rule
rules.body: Use shadows only for the scrolled navbar or genuine product previews.

dos: Do use sparse editorial rows and thin dividers.
Do keep controls at 8-12px corners and the final CTA at 16px.
donts: Don't reintroduce the former navy/teal public palette.
Don't make motion necessary for comprehension.
Don't fabricate proof or product capabilities.
